summary: Reduce to the twist places w ∈ Q (conjugate places by conjugate self-duality); there f has parahoric type, hence a product label, so R is labelled by (X − 1)(X − x_{ψ_w⁻¹}) and inertia is killed by (X − 1)(X − a(s)); chiOneInv is trivial on that inertia.

steps.claim: Let s be in the inertia group of a place A over w ∈ Q ∪ Q̄.
steps.lean: rintro s ⟨w, hv, A, hA, hs⟩

steps.claim: w is not above ℓ (the places of Q ∪ Q̄ are off badPlaces D ℓ).

It suffices that R has finite type at A and (X − a(s))(X − 1) kills s on R at A: then, ℓ being a unit at A and chiOneInv(s) = 1 on inertia (chiOneInv_spec with k = 0), the relation holds for u = normalisedRep O R.
steps.lean:
suffices IsFiniteTypeAt R A ∧ PolyKillsAt R A s ((X - C (ϑ.invAvatar s)) * (X - 1)) by
    simp_all [Units.smul_def, chiOneInv_spec hA _ 0 (inv_mem hs), PolyKillsAt,
      hA.valuation_natCast_eq_one_iff]
steps.typed_fact: IsFiniteTypeAt R A ∧ PolyKillsAt R A s ((X - C (ϑ.invAvatar s)) * (X - 1))

steps.claim: Without loss of generality w ∈ Q.
steps.lean:
wlog hw : w ∈ ϑ.Q generalizing w A s
  refine (this (conjGal s⁻¹) _ ?_ _ hA.conjPlace_star ?_ ?_ ?_).elim fun a q ↦
    cast ?_ ((local_clauses_of_conjPlace (isConjSelfDual_of_attached he h) a).imp_right
    (·.2 _ ?_ _ q)) <;> simp_all [eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left (avatar_conjGal_mul _ 0 0 s)]

steps.claim: If w ∉ Q then w̄ ∈ Q: apply the claim to conj(s⁻¹) at the conjugate place and transfer it back with local_clauses_of_conjPlace (R conjugate self-dual: isConjSelfDual_of_attached), using a(s^c)·a(s) = 1 (avatar_conjGal_mul with k = j = 0).
steps.lean:
refine (this (conjGal s⁻¹) _ ?_ _ hA.conjPlace_star ?_ ?_ ?_).elim fun a q ↦
    cast ?_ ((local_clauses_of_conjPlace (isConjSelfDual_of_attached he h) a).imp_right
    (·.2 _ ?_ _ q)) <;> simp_all [eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left (avatar_conjGal_mul _ 0 0 s)]

steps.claim: w = w_i, a twist place of O (the places of O are those of ϑ), and s has a tame exponent y at A.
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨⟨i, rfl⟩ : ∃ i, O.twistPlace i = w, y, G, -⟩ := hc.1 ▸ ⟨⟨_, hw⟩, rfl⟩,
    (exists_isTameExponent (faithfulChar (ResField w)) hA _).2 s hs

steps.claim: The avatar of ϑ⁻¹ is labelled at A by X − x_{ψ_w⁻¹} (isLabelledAt_avatar: w split, ψ trivial at w̄).
steps.lean: have := isLabelledAt_avatar ϑ.hasWeight.inv 0 0 (by simp_all [ϑ.1.5, ϑ.1.6]) (by grind) G

steps.claim: f has parahoric type (1, ψ_w⁻¹) at w (p i, with ψ_O(w) = ψ_ϑ(w) since ω is trivial at the non-chosen w), hence the product label with characters 1 and ψ_w⁻¹ (HasParahoricType.hasProductLabel); R, attached to H, is labelled at A accordingly (Attached.isLabelledAt): R has finite type at A and the polynomial with roots 1 and ιℓT(x_{ψ_w⁻¹})^y = a(s) (step 6) kills s, i.e. (X − a(s))(X − 1) kills s (aeval_eq_zero_of_roots); the alternative through an ℓ-adic embedding is excluded since ℓ is a unit at A.
steps.lean:
refine (h.isLabelledAt f.2 he (HasParahoricType.hasProductLabel (χ := ![1, _⁻¹]) (σ := 1)
    (c := 1) 1 (by tauto) ?_ (by simpa [congrFun hc.tame_part_eq.choose_spec.2 _,
    D.omega_eq_one_of_not_isChosen (D.levelNorm_mem_and_notMem_of_mem_Q _ ‹_›).2.1] using! p i)
    ?_ ?_) hA).elim fun F b ↦ ⟨F, (F.aeval_eq_zero_of_roots · hs (b.2 G).1 _ ?_),
    absurd ?_ (‹PadicPlaceEmbedding ..›.inducesPlace.1.1 ▸
    valuation_comap_intQpBar_lt_one _).ne⟩ <;> open Calc in simp_all [or_imp,
    hA.valuation_natCast_eq_one_iff, PolyKillsAt, he.1, algebraMap_eq_diagonal, funext_iff,
    labelIdem, IsLabel, asAlgebraHom_eq_sum, Hall.evalGL, ϑ.psi_ne_one]
